summary_en: Full-year ordinary dividend raised from 10 yen to 15 yen per share for the year ended December 2026, reflecting stronger-than-expected earnings driven by favorable foreign exchange and robust overseas used-car export operations.
title_en: Notice of Revisions to Full-Year Earnings Forecast and Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Apple International has increased its full-year ordinary dividend per share from 10 yen to 15 yen for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2026. This increase follows an upward revision of the full-year consolidated earnings forecast announced on February 13, 2026. The company cited stronger-than-expected performance, particularly in its overseas used-car export business, which has performed well despite initial conservative projections due to unstable international conditions, rising transportation costs from higher fuel prices, and uncertain procurement environments.

The improved outlook reflects favorable foreign exchange developments, with the yen maintaining a weak trend against major currencies. The company continues to emphasize shareholder returns as an important management objective. The dividend policy balances the need for stable, continuous dividend payments with comprehensive consideration of business plans, financial condition, quarterly earnings, ROE, and dividend payout ratios. The company intends to maintain this enhanced dividend level going forward.
